dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like you've been dealt quite a tough hand.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't even know if I'll be able to get my travel expenses reimbursed by this point. Getting here from the Akademiya was exorbitantly expensive.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: The Irminsul Fruit is more than just my thesis topic. It's a major area of interest for my supervisor... Ahem, I mean, for the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: So as well as delaying my research, it also means I've failed to complete my assignment. It's all a great big mess...
